anchors.context: For thirsty roots, use a slow trickle at soil level instead of spraying the leaves.
To feed the earth, let kitchen scraps rot into a dark material before digging it in.
Watch for tiny leaf eaters: caterpillars and beetles can strip young plants overnight.
Keep dry seedlings moist by directing water toward their root systems.
